blends.name: Blend Volume One
blends.desc:
Obtain objects of Power from our Blend Pack (https://neftyblocks.com/collection/gothsgallery/drops/190513). 
Obtain a Gothic Beauty. (https://neftyblocks.com/collection/gothsgallery/drops/188361)

Select Three objects of power. Sacrifice a Gothic Beauty.

Get 1 of 13 Mythic from the scrying pool. Limited to 37 pre minted templates each.

This is our first Blend, join our discord to provide feedback: https://discord.gg/8KAdyMTu

Check our our other collection: https://neftyblocks.com/collection/grrlbakeclub
